content.text:
(
SignIn
Mirror of the Storybook flow Flows/Auth/SignIn (src/features/auth/sign-in-modal, sign-in-view), phone only. Not a redesign.
A bottom sheet over wherever the person was. One screen offers Google, X and email; email continues to a six-digit code on the same sheet. There is no second step for new accounts: the terms line under the buttons is the whole declaration.
Drawn from the code, one look per state: choose, code, signing in, failed return (back on the method list with the error), unavailable. Dropped: the injected-wallet button and its note, which only appears when a browser wallet is present, and the loading skeleton.
Design questions for the workspace_owner: the wallet note says "your Pirate persona wallet", which names Pirate on a screen that also shows on community domains. The Google and X marks are placeholders here; the app draws the real marks.
Phone: choose, code, signing in, failed return, unavailable
